raw_response:
Exceptionally strong liquidity (current ratio 12.41) and sizable retained earnings support solvency, but the balance sheet is highly leveraged, with total liabilities equal to about 90% of assets and equity only about 10% of the asset base. Positive EBIT helps, yet operating earnings are modest relative to the very large balance sheet, which fits a lower investment-grade profile rather than a high-grade one.

DECISION: BBB-
